title: Atonement
author: Ian McEwan
summary: On a hot day in 1935, thirteen-year-old Briony misreads a scene between her sister and a family friend and makes an accusation that changes three lives. The story follows the consequences through the Second World War.
readIf: you want a beautifully written, emotionally devastating story about guilt and the stories we tell.
skipIf: you dislike slow openings or war scenes in the middle section.

pairings.reason: Another English novel about regret, class and a life shaped by something left unsaid.
A more accessible wartime story about the power of words and the cost of conflict.
A war and love story told in plain, spare prose with a similarly tragic arc.
